'''Wend''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the youngest son of [[Bordon]], and the younger brother of [[Tallo (Star-Wake)|Tallo]].

==Biography==
In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], he joined his father, brother, and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Irtanna]] aboard the [[Envoy-class shuttle|''Envoy''-class shuttle]] ''[[Star-Wake]]'' on a rescue effort on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] after the catastrophic [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]]. After the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had been destroyed by the [[Thought bomb]]'s effect, Wend, along with his brother and Irtanna went with the Republic fleet to rescue many survivors from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the mission, they rescued a girl named Rain, who was revealed to be the newly-trained [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]].

Along with the rest of the crew of the ''Star-Wake'', he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Zannah who stole the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] in order to attain transport to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. He was the last to die.
